title: Felix and the Ghost
author: Lena Kavanagh
blurb: Emrys Delacroix, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, works cases no one wants attributed. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must burn the network that did the training before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
